name: junos-mcp
description: junos-mcp server, packaged as a Claude Code plugin.

plugins.name: junos-mcp
plugins.description: MCP server for junos-ops, giving Claude Code access to Juniper JUNOS devices: show commands, config diffs and pushes, firmware upgrades, RSI/SCF diagnostics, and a daily_brief health check across a fleet. All destructive tools default to dry-run, and push_config uses commit-confirmed with an automatic post-commit rollback.
